user.title: Household Presence
user.description: Create the household. Members are added afterwards as separate entries, each with its own signals.

data_description.name: Used as the device name of the household entities.
data_description.departure_delay: How long all signals have to say "away" before a member counts as away.
Default for members without their own delay.
data_description.startup_grace: No departures are evaluated after Home Assistant starts.
data_description.just_arrived: How long a member stays in the state "just arrived".
data_description.unavailable_hours: When all signals of a member are unavailable this long, the member becomes unknown.

night.title: Night window and doors
night.description: Phones put Wi-Fi to sleep at night. In the night window a member does not leave only because home-only signals went off; a door change confirms the departure.

data_description.door_entities: Any change of these entities counts as using the door.
data_description.door_window: A door change this long before the signals went off still counts.

long_away.title: Long absence
long_away.description: Long absence always applies during vacation mode, "away until" or a vacation calendar event.

data.long_away_prediction_min: Minimum absence for the prediction rule

data_description.long_away_prediction: Long absence also when nobody is expected back within the horizon.
data_description.return_horizon: Expected return further away than this means a long absence.

data_description.household_signals: Anonymous signals that mean "someone is home" when on (e.g. TV). They do not say who.
data_description.workday_entity: Binary sensor that is on on workdays. Without it Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.multiple_min: How many members have to be home for "Several people home". The guest does not count.

data_description.vacation_keywords: Comma separated; an event whose title contains one of them means the whole household is away. Empty: every event counts.

data_description.half_life_weeks: Weeks after which a day counts half.
data_description.min_samples: Days of the same kind needed for a prediction.

data_description.no_signal_policy: What happens when no signal says home and nothing says away.
data_description.night_start: Only for an own night window.

data_description.home_states: Empty: home for person and device_tracker, otherwise on/home. For a sensor e.g. the home SSID.
data_description.away_states: Home and away signal: empty means every other state is away. Away-only signal: empty means on.
data_description.arrival_delay: The signal has to say home this long (useful for a computer or console).
data_description.max_on: A signal home for longer is considered stuck and ignored.
data_description.valid_from: Outside the time window the signal says nothing.
data_description.trust: Only a high-trust arrival ends vacation or a forced away.

plan.title: Plan from calendars
plan.description: While an event runs the member is away unless a signal sees them home.

data_description.title_filter: Comma separated; empty means every event.
data_description.lead: Leaving before the first event (way there).
data_description.trail: Coming back after the last event (way back).
data_description.certain: Off: the plan is used only for the expected return.

approach.title: Approach
approach.description: Distance and direction from home, e.g. from the Proximity integration. Leave the distance empty to turn it off.

finish.title: Cannot save
finish.description: Go back to the menu and add a signal or a plan.

error.name_exists: A member or group with this name already exists.
error.signal_exists: This entity is already a signal of the member.
error.no_signals: The member needs at least one signal or a plan.

group.title: Group
group.description: A named group of members, e.g. parents. It is home when at least the given number of its members is home.

error.name_exists: A group or member with this name already exists.
error.min_count_too_high: The number is higher than the number of selected members.

options.hold_last: Keep the last state (plan or manual only)

signal_missing.title: Missing signal of {member}
signal_missing.description: The entity {entity_id} used as a signal of {member} does not exist. Edit the member or restore the entity.

signal_stuck.title: Stuck signal of {member}
signal_stuck.description: The entity {entity_id} has said home for longer than allowed and is ignored until it changes.

calendar_unavailable.title: Calendar unavailable
calendar_unavailable.description: The calendar {entity_id} cannot be read. Its plan is not used until it works again.

member_unavailable.title: No signals of {member}
member_unavailable.description: All signals of {member} have been unavailable for a long time, the member is unknown.

member_cannot_leave.title: {member} can never leave
member_cannot_leave.description: {member} has only home-only signals, keeps the last state and has no plan. Add a home and away signal, a plan, or change the policy.

set_away_until.name: Set away until
set_away_until.description: Plans the return of the household or of one member.

member.name: Member
member.description: Name of the member; empty means the whole household.

member.name: Member
member.description: Name of the member; empty means the whole household.

member.name: Member
member.description: Name of the member; empty means everybody.

past_time.message: The time must be in the future.
